Method of Attack: Unauthenticated local WebSocket server allowing remote command execution via browser-initiated WebSocket connections to localhost
Command injection through MCP-formatted JSON-RPC 2.0 messages
Reading local files and executing code in Jupyter notebooks within the IDE
Impacted Systems: Claude Code extensions for VS Code and other IDEs (versions 1.0.23 and earlier)
Attack Vector: Browser-based exploitation via malicious websites connecting to unauthenticated localhost WebSocket servers
Cross-site WebSocket connections bypassing same-origin policy
Dynamic port brute forcing to discover active MCP server ports
Indicators of Compromise: MCP JSON-RPC 2.0 commands such as ping, tools/list, tools/call
Reading sensitive files like /etc/passwd or AWS credential files
